It depends on what US state you live in and if you're a citizen.

Free states and the firearm is new, and you're at a FFL (dealer), you fill out a Federal ATF Form 4473, in which you testify that you are not prohibited in the purchase (ATF will check). Private sales, are based on the gut feeling of the seller.

In Semi-free states, you may have to register a firearm, like a hand gun, with the local authorities, but not long guns (rifles, shotguns).

In non free states, you have to get a FOID, which is a Firearms Ownership ID and all your purchases are recorded.

Check your local laws.
